name: H6 - Mobility vs Durability: ReconSquad vs MainBattleTank
hypothesis: H6: On an open field, the MainBattleTank's superior HP, firepower, and armor should decisively defeat the ReconSquad despite the latter's mobility advantage. On a large map with obstacles, the ReconSquad may use mobility and vision to avoid direct engagement.
description: One ReconSquad vs one MainBattleTank on an open 20x20 field. This tests whether raw combat power trumps mobility in a straight fight.
expected_observations: MainBattleTank should win >85% of engagements. ReconSquad's only path to victory is through repeated hit-and-run if the terrain allows it — which it does not on an open field.
